bio: Giulia Balbi, born to a family of facchini (porters) who have served the busy docks of Venice for generations, has transformed her humble beginnings through remarkable industry and shrewd financial acumen. Despite her modest origins, Giulia has amassed a surprising fortune of over 139,000 ducats—wealth that would impress even many nobility.
